coverage: All static names available before JS.
Ready means reviewed confirmed crosswalk AND public canonical profile. Unreviewed and nonpublic confirmed rows remain pending, without profile href.
Ready, name query and selected source compose with AND.
Native change/source changes reset batch to40; Show More increments40 and focuses first newly revealed ready name.
Clear preserves ready state and selected source while clearing query.
Explicit source anchor and row deep-link reset ready and query, including pending target. Malformed hash does not change filter state.
Counts describe name/source records with reviewed profile links, not a count of Nations or canonical profiles.
Hint hidden until checked; native labeled checkbox follows inventory and precedes status; hint contains actual /nations#find link.
Older enhanced/unenhanced markup without checkbox retains original browsing.
Canonical hide_nation and takedown prevent linked directory row disclosure.
remaining_real_browser_gates: Native keyboard Space operation and visible focus.
44px checkbox/label touch row and readable wrapping at phone widths.
Theme contrast and viewport overflow checks.
Actual screen-reader/device certification is not supplied by synthetic fixtures.
limitations: Node uses an isolated DOM fixture and actual production directory script, not copied filtering logic. It tests behavior but is not a browser.
Pytest emitted an unrelated interpreter-shutdown pyreadline console warning after the measured results; preserved in log.

No future passing result or production publication is claimed.
